class.name: IfcCoolingTower
class.brief_description: A cooling tower is a device which rejects heat to ambient air by circulating a fluid such as water through it to reduce its temperature by partial evaporation. HISTORY New entity in IFC2x4 Type Use Definition IfcCoolingTower defines the occurrence of any cooling tower; common information about cooling tower types is handled by IfcCoolingTowerType .
